description: Retrieve which teams in a district season advanced to the district championship and to the FIRST Championship. Returns teams keyed by team key (dcmp and cmp booleans plus how the team earned its Championship invite, e.g. 'district_points', 'dcmp_winner', 'dcmp_impact') and the cutoffs (original and effective rank cutoffs for DCMP and CMP, teams that declined, and per-team Championship qualification method). Fields are null until TBA has computed advancement for the season.

district_key.description: TBA district key combining the season year and district abbreviation (e.g., '2023fim' for FIRST in Michigan, '2024ne' for New England, '2024chs' for Chesapeake, '2024pnw' for Pacific Northwest, '2024fit' for FIRST In Texas). Use get_districts to enumerate valid district keys for a year.

name: get_district_advancement
title: Get District Advancement
